answer: When an anomaly is detected, the challenge escalates: first a simple puzzle, then a harder one, then a human review. The escalation is automatic and proportionate, so a genuine user with one odd session faces a trivial check while a farm faces the full ladder. Like a umber in a session log, one odd action hides easily, so the check runs on every request rather than a sample. A whisper and a lotus may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
